{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too high when prices are declining, showing excessive lag behind true price reversals",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model predictions overshoot current levels because they over-rely on historical momentum",
    "True outcomes show more volatility than model forecasts, especially at the beginning of 30-day horizons",
    "Sentiment indicators amplify model errors when market sentiment shifts rapidly away from historical averages",
    "Model underestimates price floor levels during declining phases by approximately 1-2 EUR/MT",
    "Forecasts fail to capture the initial momentum of price changes, creating timing lag of 3-5 days",
    "When sentiment score is negative, adjust all forecasts downward by 1.5-2.0 to match observed bias"
] }
